title: HPE security advisory (AV26-1025)
description: As of October 8, 2026, Hewlett Packard Enterprise is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
HPE Intelligent Management Center (iMC)
	Prior to 7.3 E0713

HPE Intelligent Assurance FAS/PDO
	Version v4.2.17 and prior
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
